routes.desc: Justice Luiz Fux temporarily suspended the compulsory closure of existing betting accounts held by Bolsa Família and BPC beneficiaries, pending a conciliation hearing scheduled for February 2026.
routes.og: STF Suspends Compulsory Blocking of Bolsa Família and BPC Beneficiaries' Betting Accounts | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Senate Approves PLP 128/2025: Fiscal Tightening, Higher Taxation on Bets, Fintechs and JCP | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The Brazilian Senate approved Complementary Bill 128/2025 by 62 to 6 votes, introducing a gradual increase in the betting sector tax rate from 12% to 15% by 2028, alongside higher CSLL rates for fintechs and joint liability for payment processors facilitating illegal operators.
routes.og: Senate Approves PLP 128/2025: Fiscal Tightening, Higher Taxation on Bets, Fintechs and JCP | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Betting Sector Taxation: The Risks of Increased Tax Burden for Legal Certainty and the Regulated Market | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: A technical analysis of the risks posed by a sharp increase in the betting sector's tax burden: why higher taxation does not automatically translate to higher revenue, and what the international experience teaches about building a sustainable regulated market.
routes.og: Betting Sector Taxation: The Risks of Increased Tax Burden for Legal Certainty and the Regulated Market | Octus Consulting

routes.title: New SPA/MF Normative Instruction on Fixed-Odds Betting: Post-Licensing Obligations | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The Secretariat of Prizes and Betting published a new Normative Instruction establishing the procedures for authorised fixed-odds betting operators to communicate changes to their licence conditions and notify the commencement of operational activities.
routes.og: New SPA/MF Normative Instruction on Fixed-Odds Betting: Post-Licensing Obligations | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Centralised Self-Exclusion Platform: Key Changes for Operators and Bettors | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: From 10 December 2025, the Centralised Self-Exclusion Platform entered into operation, enabling any person to block access to all authorised betting sites in Brazil through a single procedure at gov.br/autoexclusaoapostas.
routes.og: Centralised Self-Exclusion Platform: Key Changes for Operators and Bettors | Octus Consulting

routes.title: STF Suspends Municipal Lottery Operations Nationwide, Orders Immediate Cessation | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Justice Kassio Nunes Marques suspended all municipal regulations authorising lottery and sports betting operations across Brazil, ordering immediate cessation and imposing daily fines of BRL 500,000 for non-compliant municipalities and companies.
routes.og: STF Suspends Municipal Lottery Operations Nationwide, Orders Immediate Cessation | Octus Consulting

routes.title: The COAF Institutional Challenges and AML Obligations for Online Gaming Operators | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: An analysis of Brazil's financial intelligence unit (COAF) institutional limitations and the practical steps gaming operators must take to maintain robust anti-money laundering compliance regardless of external pressures on the regulatory system.
routes.og: The COAF Institutional Challenges and AML Obligations for Online Gaming Operators | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Annual Recertification of Betting Platforms: What Changes Under SPA/MF New Guidelines | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: SPA/MF has issued complementary guidance on the mandatory annual technical recertification of fixed-odds betting platforms, establishing binding rules for operators, suppliers and certifying entities.
routes.og: Annual Recertification of Betting Platforms: What Changes Under SPA/MF New Guidelines | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Risk Management Software in iGaming: Technology as a Regulatory Pillar | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Risk management software has evolved from a best practice into an inescapable regulatory requirement for iGaming operators in Brazil. Understanding what the technology must do: and how it must be integrated with human expertise: is now central to compliance.
routes.og: Risk Management Software in iGaming: Technology as a Regulatory Pillar | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Customised Structural Studies for International Expansion into Brazil | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: International expansion into Brazil requires more than incorporating a local entity. Octus structures customised studies that analyse cross-border corporate architecture and present tailored strategic scenarios for Brazil entry.
routes.og: Customised Structural Studies for International Expansion into Brazil | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Rio de Janeiro Regulates VLTs and Lottery Terminals with New State Decree | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Governor Cláudio Castro's Decree No. 49,804/2025 establishes requirements for Video Lottery Terminals and other lottery equipment in Rio de Janeiro, all under LOTERJ supervision, with potential for 65,000 direct and indirect jobs.
routes.og: Rio de Janeiro Regulates VLTs and Lottery Terminals with New State Decree | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Games Not Classified as Fixed-Odds Betting in Brazil: Understanding the Legal Distinctions | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Ordinance SPA/MF No. 1,207/2024 establishes that certain online game modalities (skill games, fantasy sports, multiplayer games and P2P betting) fall outside the fixed-odds betting regime and therefore do not require a federal betting licence.
routes.og: Games Not Classified as Fixed-Odds Betting in Brazil: Understanding the Legal Distinctions | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Extension of the .bet.br Domain to Brazilian States: Regulatory Trust Seal Expands | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The SPA's proposed extension of the .bet.br domain to Brazilian states participating in the National Betting System (SINAPO) creates a digital trust seal differentiating authorised from illegal operators across the federal structure.
routes.og: Extension of the .bet.br Domain to Brazilian States: Regulatory Trust Seal Expands | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Intellectual Property in iGaming: Avoiding Critical Errors in Trademark Registration | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Trademark registration in the betting sector is a specialised field. The INPI systematically rejects registrations linked to 'bet', 'casino' or 'aposta', and a poorly constructed defence in an appeal can mean the permanent loss of a valuable brand.
routes.og: Intellectual Property in iGaming: Avoiding Critical Errors in Trademark Registration | Octus Consulting

routes.title: The National Betting System (SINAPO): What It Is and Why It Could Change Brazilian Betting Regulation | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The SPA/MF has initiated the creation of SINAPO, the National Betting System, a cooperative federal initiative to harmonise betting regulation across Brazil's 26 states and the Federal District through minimum national standards.
routes.og: The National Betting System (SINAPO): What It Is and Why It Could Change Brazilian Betting Regulation | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Why Your International Licence May Not Protect You in Brazil | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Holding a licence from Malta, Curaçao or the Isle of Man is no longer sufficient for operators seeking to operate in Brazil. With Law 14,790/2023 fully in force, only operators with a federal SPA/MF authorisation may legally accept Brazilian players.
routes.og: Why Your International Licence May Not Protect You in Brazil | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Regulation and Technology: How Legal Keeps Pace with iGaming Innovation | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The iGaming sector continues to change through new technology, business models and tools such as machine learning in product and risk workflows. Legal counsel must stay close to those operational shifts: this article is sector commentary, not an Octus product claim.
routes.og: Regulation and Technology: How Legal Keeps Pace with iGaming Innovation | Octus Consulting

routes.title: IOF Update: Key Implications for the Financial Market and Regulated Industries | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The Brazilian Federal Revenue Service issued clarifications on the IOF following the suspension of temporary regulations, indicating that financial institutions are not required to collect retroactively: but a future direct charge on taxpayers remains possible.
routes.og: IOF Update: Key Implications for the Financial Market and Regulated Industries | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Trump Signs Tax Reform Imposing New Betting Taxation in the US: Lessons for Brazil | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act limits the deduction of gambling losses to 90%, meaning US bettors may owe federal taxes even on net-loss years. The measure raises BRL 1.14 billion in revenue projections but risks driving players to offshore platforms: a lesson Brazil is simultaneously learning.
routes.og: Trump Signs Tax Reform Imposing New Betting Taxation in the US: Lessons for Brazil | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Regulatory Agenda 2025/2026: SPA/MF Sets the Course for Brazil's Betting Market | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Ordinance SPA/MF No. 817/2025 establishes the regulatory agenda for Brazil's sports betting and online gaming market for the 2025-2026 biennium, including B2B regulation, a national trust seal, the SINAPO cooperative system and a revised authorisation procedure.
routes.og: Regulatory Agenda 2025/2026: SPA/MF Sets the Course for Brazil's Betting Market | Octus Consulting

routes.title: SPA Ordinance Requires Banks and Payment Institutions to Refuse Accounts for Illegal Betting Operators | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The SPA/MF published an ordinance requiring financial institutions, payment institutions and payment scheme managers to refuse or terminate relationships with companies operating fixed-odds betting illegally, with a 24-hour notification obligation.
routes.og: SPA Ordinance Requires Banks and Payment Institutions to Refuse Accounts for Illegal Betting Operators | Octus Consulting

routes.title: YouTube Tightens Rules Against Illegal Betting Sites: Impact on Influencers and Content Creators | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: YouTube implemented new mechanisms to block content related to illegal online gambling sites from 19 March 2025, following denunciations of influencers promoting betting platforms with misleading profit guarantees.
routes.og: YouTube Tightens Rules Against Illegal Betting Sites: Impact on Influencers and Content Creators | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Brazil to Implement Registration Requirement for B2B Providers in the Betting and iGaming Market | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Brazil's SPA Secretary announced at ICE Barcelona that a mandatory registration mechanism for B2B providers in the regulated market is being implemented: covering game providers, platforms, KYC tools and other essential services.
routes.og: Brazil to Implement Registration Requirement for B2B Providers in the Betting and iGaming Market | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Quinel Credentialed as Certifying Entity by Brazil's Ministry of Finance, with Octus Legal Support | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: Historical note (2024): with Octus legal support, Quinel Limited was credentialed by Brazil's Ministry of Finance as a certifying entity for betting systems under Ordinance SPA/MF No. 300/2024. Credential counts change over time; verify current SPA/MF listings.
routes.og: Quinel Credentialed as Certifying Entity by Brazil's Ministry of Finance, with Octus Legal Support | Octus Consulting

routes.title: Senate Commission Approves Bill to Legalise Casinos, Bingos, Jogo do Bicho and Online Games in Brazil | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee approved the rapporteur's report on PL 2234/22 by 14 votes to 12, advancing legislation to legalise casinos, bingos, jogo do bicho and online gaming in Brazil: the bill now proceeds to the full Senate.
routes.og: Senate Commission Approves Bill to Legalise Casinos, Bingos, Jogo do Bicho and Online Games in Brazil | Octus Consulting

routes.title: SPA/MF Clarification: Brazilian Partner Requirement: 20% Share Capital Threshold | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The SPA/MF confirmed via its FAQ that the requirement for a Brazilian partner holding at least 20% of the applicant company's share capital may be met by either Brazilian natural persons or Brazilian legal entities incorporated under Brazilian law.
routes.og: SPA/MF Clarification: Brazilian Partner Requirement: 20% Share Capital Threshold | Octus Consulting

routes.title: New Rules for Sports Betting and Online Games in Brazil: Portaria SPA/MF 827/2024 | Octus Consulting | Octus Consulting
routes.desc: The SPA/MF published Ordinance No. 827/2024 defining the rules and conditions for obtaining authorisation to operate sports betting and online games in Brazil: covering a five-year licence, BRL 30 million capital requirement and comprehensive qualification criteria.
